title: Night Shift
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A slinky late-night UK garage workout built on a warm sine sub-bass that breathes and swells through a slow filter sweep. Shuffled AkaiLinn hats and a syncopated two-step kick carry you through a continuous evolution from stripped intro to euphoric peak, with glassy arpeggios and a silky sawtooth lead weaving in and out across six sections.
